symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: The exterior ventilation grilles are blocked.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the exterior ventilation grilles.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The exterior ventilation grilles are blocked."

symptoms.symptom: A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
remedies: Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Pack the food airtight or cover it.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
Always leave some space between the food and the interior walls.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Different causes are possible.
remedies: Switch the appliance back on after five minutes.
Page 12 If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "Different causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: The base of the refrigerator compartment is wet.

causes.label: The condensation channel or drainage hole are blocked.
remedies: Clean the condensation channel and the drainage hole. Page 17
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "The condensation channel or drainage hole are blocked."

symptoms.symptom: The appliance hums, bubbles, buzzes, gargles or clicks.

causes.label: Not a fault. A motor is running, e.g. refrigerating unit, fan. Refrigerant flows through the pipes. The motor, switches or solenoid valves are switching on or off. No action required.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "Not a fault. A motor is running, e.g. refrigerating unit, fan. Refrigerant flows through the pipes. The motor, switches or solenoid valves are switching on or off. No action required."

causes.label: Fittings wobble or stick.
remedies: Check the removable fittings and, if required, replace these.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "Fittings wobble or stick."

causes.label: Bottles or containers are touching.
remedies: Move the bottles or containers away from each other.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "Bottles or containers are touching."

causes.label: Super freezing is switched on. No action required.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 20: "Super freezing is switched on. No action required."
